name: Welcome new lead
subject: Welcome to Lansan Connect, {{first_name}}!
body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Thank you for reaching out! We're thrilled to learn more about {{company}} and help you streamline your sales operations.

Would you have 15 minutes for a brief call tomorrow?

Best regards,
LaToya

name: Follow-up email
subject: Checking in — {{company}}
body:
Hi {{first_name}},

I wanted to follow up on our recent conversation. Do you have 15 minutes this week to reconnect?

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Best,
LaToya

name: Proposal sent
subject: Your proposal from Lansan Connect
body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Please find attached your custom proposal for {{service}}. I'm confident this solution will deliver measurable results for {{company}}.

Let me know if you have any questions.

Warm regards,
LaToya
